cause: The Windows CI desktop clamped requested 1600x700 to 1028x700; screenshots immediately after resize were blank.
additional_windows_finding: After resize the Windows screen presentation retained a clipped or scaled viewport. The actual GLFW framebuffer viewport and window-coordinate projection are now set explicitly before drawing the full-window backdrop and UI.
initial_test_correction: Use desktop-supported 800x600 and 960x450 diagnostic windows; allow ten rendered frames before capture. Production driving and menu render code unchanged by this test correction.
correction: Use supported diagnostic window sizes, allow resize settling, and explicitly reset the screen viewport/projection to the actual GLFW framebuffer before presentation.
validation_script_correction: Parenthesize PowerShell subtraction in array elements and avoid the automatic Error variable.
remaining_bars_confirmed_cause: The final source-pixel comparison revealed black gutters baked into the original images. 0.18.1 uses measured useful content rectangles for all fifteen backgrounds.
